objective: Strengthen LEGO's association with creativity and imaginative problem solving.
businessContext: LEGO launched its first global brand advertising campaign in more than 30 years.
strategy: Make rebuilding an expression of the product system and a participatory platform.
outcomes: LEGO continued the platform and reported that it attracted new builders.
whatWorked: The organizing idea was native to the product behavior.
The platform supported both communications and participation.
whatFailed: Company reporting does not isolate incremental commercial impact.
transferConditions: The brand idea is demonstrable through the product experience and supports repeated participation.
nonTransferConditions: Do not copy a broad purpose platform when the product cannot enact it.
